name: Engraving
description: Engraved rules two to a row, each swelling to a long lens and tapering to a hairline, their weight following a smooth field so a cloud of tone is cut in line alone.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --w: @rn(-0.3, 1.5, 1.4); --s: $(max(0.08, min(1, w))); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1%; top: 0; width: 102%; height: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lens); clip-path: @var(--lens); -webkit-transform: scaleY($(s)); transform: scaleY($(s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1%; top: 50%; width: 102%; height: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lens); clip-path: @var(--lens); -webkit-transform: scaleY($(s)); transform: scaleY($(s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
